title: Outer Wilds: The Last Evening
alt: A red giant sun above a forested valley at night. A traveler sits at a campfire on a cliff beside a small spacecraft, and planets hang in a sky of star trails.
summary: A painting of a scene from Outer Wilds in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is a scene from Outer Wilds, a game by Mobius Digital. The sun is a red giant above Timber Hearth. A traveler sits at a campfire on a cliff, next to the ship.
The Hourglass Twins cross the sun. Giant’s Deep, the Attlerock, Brittle Hollow, Dark Bramble and the Interloper are in the sky. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
